_comment: Deliberate exceptions to the hardcoded-string audit (scripts/i18n-audit.mjs strings).
src/i18n/__tests__/drained.test.js checks the CURRENT audit output is a SUBSET of this
file: anything listed is free, anything new fails. Counted per file, so a second copy
of a listed string pasted into the same file still counts as new.
2026-09-23: that test read zero findings from merge 580afffe (2026-08-31) on. The
merge kept main's audit, which prints a line number before each finding, over the
8016e51f audit this list was generated from, and the parser only knew the old
bare-JSON lines. None of the 82 entries listed here appear in today's audit output,
so they are gone: 57 no longer exist verbatim (localized or rewritten), 7 were code
shapes today's IGNORE drops, and 18 are STILL hardcoded but invisible to today's
text pattern (after a self-closing tag, starting with punctuation, or holding an
HTML entity). Widening that pattern will surface those 18 as new findings, which
is the point. What remains below is not debt; it is text that should not be
translated:
- the preview cast (Nell Okafor, Priya Raines, Prime Cut Studio, Rowan Marsh and
their initials). src/data/previewMail.js keeps cast and brands untranslated, the
same rule the marketing screenshots follow.
- an example endpoint URL and model id shown as input placeholders.
- code the audit text pattern misreads: a regex literal (T\d) and a for-of loop.
Adding an entry is a reviewed exception, not a way to silence a red test: a new
hardcoded string should be wrapped in t() instead. Localizing a listed string and
deleting its entry is always safe.
